Who we clear

Large commercial properties only

Captain Handy looks after big sites where a blocked lot means lost business, liability risk, or residents and patients who can't get in. If your property is on this list, it fits.

Retail plazas

Customer parking, storefront entrances and loading areas cleared before doors open.

Office buildings & towers

Lots, parkades, ramps and main entrances kept passable for staff and visitors.

Condos & multi-residential

Resident parking, visitor lots, fire routes and walkways for condo and rental properties.

Warehouses & industrial

Yards, truck courts and loading docks kept moving through every storm.

Medical & institutional

Clinics, care facilities and institutional grounds where access can't wait for the melt.

Please note: Captain Handy services large commercial areas only. Single homes and residential driveways are not serviced.
Services

Everything a big lot needs, one crew

Commercial plowing

Lots, laneways and internal roads plowed with loaders and trucks matched to your site's size.

Salting & ice management

Salting and ice control for lots, entrances and walkways to cut slip-and-fall risk.

Snow hauling & relocation

When piles eat your parking, snow is loaded, hauled away or relocated on site.

Loading docks

Dock doors, aprons and truck courts cleared so deliveries keep their schedule.

Fire routes

Fire routes and emergency access lanes kept clear and passable at all times.

Entrances

Main entrances, receiving doors and pedestrian access points cleared and salted.

Contract options

Three ways to contract the season

Pick the billing style that matches how your property runs. Every contract starts with a site walk and a written quote — Captain Handy does not publish a price list, because every large property prices differently.

Most predictable

Seasonal contract

Best for: property managers who want one fixed winter budget, set before the first storm.

  • Plowing on every event at the 5 cm trigger, all season
  • Salting & ice management included as contracted
  • 24/7 dispatch — no calls needed during a storm
  • Photo report after every visit
  • One fixed seasonal price, quoted after your site walk
Book a site walk

Per push

Best for: properties that prefer to pay only when crews actually clear.

  • Pay per clearing visit ("push"), triggered at 5 cm
  • Salting available per application
  • 24/7 coverage during snow events
  • Photo report after every visit
  • Per-visit rate quoted after your site walk
Book a site walk

On-call / emergency

Best for: sites with their own equipment that need backup, or one-off clearing and hauling.

  • Call-out clearing when your own crew can't keep up
  • Snow hauling & relocation when piles take over
  • Loading dock and fire-route rescue clearing
  • Photo report after the visit
  • Call-out pricing quoted when you call

Request a site walk

Tell us about the property and pick a preferred date. A site walk is how every Captain Handy quote starts — the crew measures the lot, checks docks and fire routes, and prices the property properly.

What happens next

  • Your request is reviewed and you're contacted to confirm the site-walk time.
  • The crew walks and measures the property — lot, docks, fire routes, entrances.
  • You receive a written quote for the contract type you chose. No obligation to sign.

    What counts as a "valid enquiry"

    A real enquiry from a property manager or property owner about a commercial property Captain Handy services, including the property details (type, address and approximate lot size) and a contactable name plus a phone number or email address. Test submissions, spam, residential driveway requests and duplicates of the same property don't count and aren't billed.
